text:
alice_pr: FYI team 11: our CEO Maya is publishing a short op-ed about inference economics at 14:00 PT. We'll need a coordinated launch: blog post, exec TL;DR, and a press note. Can marketing + eng confirm readiness?

carl_marketing: Got it. Draft social thread and blog are ready. Want PR to approve the headline and lead quote.

sam_engineering: Quick tech check: the blog references a chart comparing latency/cost across modes. Those numbers are final, but if press asks for raw data we should send a redacted CSV. Ops can scrub.

alice_pr: PR wants a one-paragraph boilerplate for press and a safe quote from Maya for the press note. Maya, do you have a preferred short quote?

maya_ceo: Use this: "Serving is the new moat: predictable, cost-effective inference is what scales product impact." You can shorten if needed. Also please include a note that dedicated/private customers can request a briefing.

carl_marketing: Nice. I'll run that through the headline variants: "Serving is the new moat: how to make inference predictable" or "Serving is the new moat: making inference predictable and economical." Which do you prefer, Maya?
maya_ceo: Second one. "Serving is the new moat: making inference predictable and economical."

alice_pr: PR-approved quote included. Draft press note: "Redwood Inference CEO Maya [LastName] outlines the operational shift from model ownership to serving. For interviews and customer briefings contact press@redwood.com." Short and neutral. Approve?
carl_marketing: Approve. Scheduling: blog post 14:00 PT, social 14:05 PT, press note 14:10 PT. Buffer entries queued.
sam_engineering: Ops: please prepare scrubbed CSV and one-slide methodology summary in case reporters request it.

press_bot: press_listening: monitoring enabled

alice_pr: Ops confirmed scrubbed CSV ready and uploaded to secure share. PR will attach on request.

carl_marketing: All scheduled. I'll ping channels when live and post the internal TL;DR to #all-hands at 14:15 PT.
maya_ceo: Thanks everyone. Short heads-up for Sales: include the new quote in pitches but lead with customer outcomes.

alice_pr: Live update: blog and op-ed posted at 14:00 PT, social posted at 14:05 PT, press note sent at 14:10 PT. Link: https://redwood.example/blog/serving-is-the-new-moat

press_bot: article_posted: https://redwood.example/blog/serving-is-the-new-moat

carl_marketing: Internal TL;DR posted to #all-hands and #sales. Also uploaded a 1-slide summary to the sales drive.

sam_engineering: Noticed one small typo in the methodology caption - fixed and pushed an erratum on the blog. No impact on numbers.

alice_pr: Closing loop 14:30 PT. Saved assets and added a short postmortem checklist item: clarify data-attachment process for reporters to speed future requests. If anyone sees press pickup, drop links here. :white_check_mark:"
